summary: Decimal parsing counted trailing zeros toward the 768-digit limit and incorrectly marked values as truncated when only zero padding was discarded. This makes halfway values round upward instead of ties-to-even. The fix removes trailing zeros before checking the digit limit while preserving the decimal point. The existing test_f64_general in tests/test_basic.rs checks 9007199254740993.0 with 1000 appended zeros against 9007199254740992.0. No tests were executed.
